format_note: Every stable NPC ID carries authored return/aid/local world text; persistent counters are saved by ResidentContinuity. Avoid treating community effects as direct eyewitness reports.

residents.name: The stallkeeper
residents.recognize_line: The stallkeeper: "I remember you. We spoke near the road between shelter and records; I kept your place at the stall. The price can wait while we finish our conversation."
residents.aid_line: The stallkeeper: "When you helped, I kept a spare supply aside for the next stranger, not a debt against you."
residents.public_line: The stallkeeper: "Our road between shelter and records has changed, and I can speak about what happened here. I cannot swear to what a far-off witness saw."
residents.post_morning: The stallkeeper: "The morning looks different above the road between shelter and records. I remember who I was before the light changed."
residents.personal_concern: Keep the road between shelter and records safe while allowing its residents to disagree.
residents.next_visit_hook: Ask about the road between shelter and records on a later day; do not assume a stranger's loyalty is bought.
